detail: Full summary: Empirical panel ground truth on 417 real decisions: 275 have alternatives (402 entries). 181 records / 217 entries are NL-path, ALL carrying 'Not chosen'; 94 records / 185 entries are structured, every reason distinct and real. 'Not chosen' is the only reason_rejected value in the entire corpus that repeats — a zero-false-positive path discriminator. Option LENGTH is not a detector (placeholder p50=32 vs structured p50=44), confirming my earlier over-count correction.
